mapper.select: SELECT ppi.PK_ID personnelInterviewId, ppi.TITLE title, picf.PK_ID picId, wordf.PK_ID wordId FROM PPM.PPM_PERSONNEL_INTERVIEW ppi LEFT JOIN PPM.PPM_PERSONNEL_INTERVIEW_FILE picf ON picf.PERSONNEL_INTERVIEW_ID = ppi.PK_ID AND picf."TYPE" = '0' AND picf.DELETED != '1' LEFT JOIN PPM.PPM_PERSONNEL_INTERVIEW_FILE wordf ON wordf.PERSONNEL_INTERVIEW_ID = ppi.PK_ID AND wordf."TYPE" = '1' AND wordf.DELETED != '1' WHERE ppi.DELETED != '1' ORDER BY ppi.CREATE_DATE DESC
